issue.detail: Spec leaves clock-edge polarity unspecified; rule assumes posedge, but negedge-triggered DFF is plausible.
issue.spec_evidence: Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0).
issue.alternative: negedge-triggered D flip-flop: q updates to d (or 0 when r=1) at negedge; posedge does not update q.
